source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: A Holiday Dinner, Cornell Cooperative Extension of Onondaga County

steps.instruction: Drain 1 can (20 ounces) of pineapple chunks and 1 1/3 cups of mandarin oranges.
steps.spoken: Drain the pineapple chunks and the mandarin oranges. You can use the juice as a drink.

steps.instruction: Put the pineapple, oranges, 1 sliced banana and 1 1/2 cups of grapes in a bowl.
Mix in 3/4 cup of miniature marshmallows and 1/3 cup of flaked coconut.
Fold in 1 cup (8 ounces) of low-fat vanilla yogurt.
Chill the ambrosia in the refrigerator, then serve.

source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: Adapted from University of Minnesota Cooperative Extension Service

steps.instruction: Wash your hands, then clean the utensils and counter top.
steps.spoken: Wash your hands with soap and water. Make sure the utensils and counter top are clean.

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 375 °F.
Mix 1 cup of mashed banana, 1/2 cup of yogurt and 1/4 cup of water.
Add 1 cup of quick oats and mix well.
steps.spoken: Add 1 cup of quick oats, not instant oats, and mix well.

steps.instruction: Add 1/2 cup of raisins or sunflower seeds if you like, and mix well.
Add cinnamon to taste if you like, and mix well.
Check that the batter is thick and easy to scoop with a spoon.
Grease a baking sheet.
Place 1 tablespoon of dough on the sheet and press it into a flat disk.
steps.spoken: Place 1 tablespoon of dough on the sheet and press it lightly into a flat disk. Repeat with the rest of the dough.

steps.instruction: Refrigerate any dough left in the bowl.
Bake the cookies for 20 minutes.
Flip the cookies and bake 15 more minutes to make 25 small crisp cookies.
steps.spoken: Flip the cookies and bake them 15 more minutes, until they are crisp. This makes 25 small cookies.

source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: A Harvest of Recipes with USDA Foods, USDA Food Distribution Program on Indian Reservations, Adapted from a recipe submitted by Alicson Scott, Chickasaw Nation, Get Fresh! Nutrition Education Program

ingredients.name: low-sodium whole kernel corn, about 23 ounces

steps.instruction: Add 1 pound of ground beef to a large pan over medium heat.
steps.spoken: Brown the beef for 8 to ten minutes.

steps.instruction: Drain the fat off the beef.
Add 1 1/2 cans of corn and 1 can of carrots to the pot.
Add 1 can of sliced potatoes and 1 can of diced tomatoes to the pot.
Add 1 small diced onion to the pot.
Cook over medium heat for 25 minutes, stirring now and then.
steps.spoken: Cook over medium heat for 25 minutes. Stir about every ten minutes.

steps.instruction: Add 1/2 cup of dry macaroni to the pot.
Add 1 teaspoon of garlic powder and 1 teaspoon of onion powder.
Cook over medium heat for 20 minutes, stirring now and then.
steps.spoken: Cook over medium heat for 20 minutes. Stir about every ten minutes.

beef-vegetable-soup-with-noodles.title: Beef and Vegetable Soup with Noodles

ingredients.name: no salt added cut green beans, 14.5-ounce can
no salt added stewed tomatoes, 14.5-ounce can

steps.instruction: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a 4-quart saucepan over medium-high heat.
Brown 1 pound of lean ground beef in the hot oil, stirring often.
steps.spoken: Cook the beef until it is well browned on all sides, stirring often.

steps.instruction: Remove the beef to a bowl with a slotted spoon.
Add 1 diced onion and 2 minced garlic cloves to the drippings over medium heat.
Cook until the onion and garlic are tender-crisp.
Add 1 can of beef broth, 1 can of carrots and 1 can of green beans.
Add 1 can of stewed tomatoes, 1 teaspoon of dried basil and the browned beef.
Heat over high heat until the soup boils.
Reduce the heat to low and cover the pan.
Simmer for 10 minutes, stirring now and then.
steps.spoken: Simmer for 10 to fifteen minutes to blend the flavors, stirring now and then.

steps.instruction: Stir in 1 cup of cooked egg noodles.

ingredients.name: chili powder, or more to taste
low-sodium black beans, 15.5 ounces each, drained and rinsed in cold water (or 6 cups cooked dried black beans)

steps.instruction: Heat 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil in a large soup pot over medium heat.
Add 1 Spanish onion, 2 diced carrots and 2 diced celery stalks.
Add 4 minced garlic cloves and 1 teaspoon each of dried basil and oregano.
Add 2 teaspoons of chili powder.
Cook for about 10 minutes, until the onion is soft.
Add 3 cans of black beans and 8 cups of water.
Add 1 low sodium chicken bouillon cube.
Raise the heat to high and bring to a boil.
Turn the heat down to low and cook for 2 1/2 hours.
steps.spoken: Cook until the beans are very tender and the mixture is the same color throughout.

steps.instruction: If you want a pureed soup, set the soup aside to cool for about 20 minutes.
Put 2 cups of soup in a blender and put the lid on halfway.
steps.spoken: Put 2 cups of soup in a blender and put the lid on halfway. This lets the soup expand and the steam escape.

steps.instruction: Blend until smooth.
Transfer the blended soup to a large container.
Repeat with the rest of the soup.
Just before serving, squeeze the juice of 1/4 lime on each serving.
Top each serving with 1 tablespoon of yogurt.
steps.spoken: Top each serving with 1 tablespoon of yogurt. Serve right away, or cover and refrigerate for up to five days.

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 350 °F.
Add 8 ounces of cubed cheese and 1 can of mushrooms to a large bowl.
Add 1 can of sweet peas and 3 cups of cooked brown rice.
Mix everything together.
Coat a 1 1/2-quart baking pan with cooking spray.
Move the mixture to the baking pan.
Cover the pan and bake for 20 minutes.
steps.spoken: Cover the pan and bake for 20 to twenty-five minutes.

steps.instruction: Sprinkle 1/2 cup of slivered almonds on top.
Bake 5 minutes more.

brown-rice-pilaf-with-sage-and-walnuts.title: Brown Rice Pilaf with Sage and Walnuts

source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: Diet & Cancer, American Institute for Cancer Research

ingredients.name: celery stalk, ends trimmed and chopped

steps.instruction: Spray a large skillet with cooking spray.
Heat the skillet over medium heat.
Add 1 chopped onion and 1 chopped celery stalk to the skillet.
steps.spoken: Add 1 chopped onion and 1 chopped celery stalk to the skillet. Stir for about 5 minutes, until tender.

steps.instruction: Add 2 cups of brown rice and stir for 5 minutes.
Add 2 1/2 cups of water and 2 cups of vegetable broth.
Add 1/4 cup of raisins and 1/4 cup of chopped dried apricots.
Heat the skillet until the liquid boils.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 50 minutes.
steps.spoken: Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for about 50 minutes, until the rice is tender and the liquid is absorbed.

steps.instruction: Stir in 1 teaspoon of dried sage and 1/4 cup of chopped walnuts, if you like.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste, if you like.
Move the pilaf to a serving dish and sprinkle with 2 teaspoons of fresh sage.
Preheat the oven to 425 °F.
Mix 1/4 cup of panko breadcrumbs and 1/4 cup of cheddar cheese in a shallow dish.
Stir in 1 tablespoon of smoked paprika-garlic blend.
Pat 2 chicken breasts dry with a paper towel.
Slice into the side of each breast, leaving 1/2 inch uncut at the far end.
steps.spoken: Slice into the thick side of each breast, parallel to the cutting board, and leave 1/2 inch uncut at the far end.

steps.instruction: Open the chicken like a book and season both sides with salt and pepper.
Coat one side of each breast with 2 tablespoons of mayonnaise.
Press the coated side into the crumb mixture, one breast at a time.
Put the chicken on a parchment-lined baking sheet, coated side up.
Bake on the middle oven rack for 18 minutes.
steps.spoken: Bake on the middle oven rack for 18 to twenty minutes, until a thermometer reads 165 °F in the thickest part.

ingredients.name: green bell pepper, rinsed and sliced in pieces 1/4 inch wide by 2 inches long
zucchini, rinsed and shredded finely or sliced into small chunks (about 1 cup)
chickpeas, low-sodium, 15 1/2 ounces, drained and rinsed
fresh basil, rinsed, dried and cut into thin strips (or 1 teaspoon dried)

steps.instruction: Bring 3 quarts of water to a boil in a 4-quart saucepan over high heat.
Add 8 ounces of whole-wheat fusilli to the boiling water.
steps.spoken: Add the pasta and cook it for the shortest time on the package, about 8 to nine minutes.

steps.instruction: Drain the pasta.
Rinse the pasta under cold running water for 3 minutes.
Place 2 cups of halved cherry tomatoes in a large salad bowl.
Add 1 sliced green bell pepper and 1/2 cup of sliced red onion.
Add 1 shredded medium zucchini and 1 can of drained chickpeas.
Season with 1 tablespoon of basil, 1/4 teaspoon of salt and 1/8 teaspoon of pepper.
Add the cooled pasta.
Mix 1 tablespoon of olive oil and 2 tablespoons of balsamic vinegar in a small bowl.
steps.spoken: Mix the olive oil and the balsamic vinegar in a small bowl until completely blended.

steps.instruction: Pour the dressing over the salad and mix gently until well coated.
Divide into 4 portions and top each with 2 tablespoons of shredded parmesan cheese.
Chop 1 large onion and mince 3 cloves of garlic.
Heat 2 to 3 tablespoons of olive oil in a large tall pot over medium-low heat.
Add the onion and stir constantly for 5 minutes, until it starts to brown.
steps.spoken: Add the chopped onion to the pot and stir constantly for 5 to ten minutes, until it begins to brown.

steps.instruction: Add the garlic near the end of the onion's browning, and cook 1 minute.
steps.spoken: Add the minced garlic near the end of the onion's browning, and cook for 1 to two minutes.

steps.instruction: Add the 29-ounce can of tomato sauce and the 15-ounce can of diced tomatoes.
Add 4 cans of kidney beans, 1/2 can of sweet corn and 1 cup of cooked rice.
Turn up the heat to medium.
Add 1 teaspoon each of cumin, smoked paprika, garlic powder and onion powder.
Add 1 tablespoon each of chili powder and crushed red pepper.
Taste the chili and adjust the seasoning.
Cook for 20 minutes, stirring now and then.
steps.spoken: Cook for 20 to thirty minutes, stirring now and then.

source.name: NHLBI (NIH)
source.credit: NHLBI, NIH; Delicious Heart Healthy Latino Recipes

steps.instruction: Heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil in a large soup pot over medium heat.
Add 2 diced carrots, 2 chopped celery stalks and 1 chopped onion.
steps.spoken: Add 2 diced carrots, 2 chopped celery stalks and 1 small chopped onion. Cook and stir until the onion is tender.

steps.instruction: Stir in 2 cloves of garlic, 1 teaspoon of oregano and 1 teaspoon of basil.
Stir in 1/2 teaspoon of pepper and cook for 2 minutes.
Stir in 2 cups of dry lentils and 1 can of crushed tomatoes.
Add 2 cups of vegetable broth and 6 1/2 cups of water.
Cover the pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat and simmer for 1 hour.
steps.spoken: Reduce the heat and simmer for at least 1 hour, until the lentils are tender.

steps.instruction: Store leftovers in the refrigerator.
steps.spoken: Store leftovers in the refrigerator. Reheat them on the stove or in the microwave.

ingredients.name: rose pepper, green pepper and black pepper, freshly ground

steps.instruction: Grind 1 tablespoon of rose pepper, green pepper and black pepper.
Put the pepper in a pan and roast it for 1 minute, moving it with a spatula.
Stir in 1 teaspoon of Dijon mustard and 7 tablespoons of bouillon.
Bring the pan to a boil.
Add 7/8 cup of cream.
Cook on medium heat for 10 minutes, until the sauce thickens.
steps.spoken: Cook on medium heat for 10 to twenty minutes, until the sauce thickens.

steps.instruction: Taste the sauce and add salt if needed.
Add 1 1/4 pounds of tomatoes and 1 can of canned tomatoes to a food processor.
Add 1 green onion, 1 red onion, 1 jalapeno pepper and 1 clove of garlic.
Add 1 handful of fresh cilantro.
Add the juice of 1/2 lime, 1 chili pepper and 1/4 teaspoon of cumin, if you like.
Pulse in short bursts until the salsa is as chunky as you like.
Refrigerate the salsa until you serve it, for up to 1 week.
steps.spoken: Refrigerate the salsa until you serve it. It keeps for up to 1 week. This makes about 14 servings.

steps.instruction: Put 3/4 cup of flour in a bowl.
Put 2 beaten eggs in a second bowl.
Mix 1 1/2 cups of bread crumbs with salt and paprika in a third bowl.
Wash 4 veal cutlets.
Gently dry the veal with a paper towel.
Beat the veal on a board with a tenderizer or rolling pin to 1/4 inch thick.
steps.spoken: Beat the veal on a board with a meat tenderizer or a rolling pin until it is about 1/4 inch thick. Beating makes the veal tender.

steps.instruction: Season the veal with salt and pepper on both sides.
Dip each piece of veal in the flour, then the eggs, then the bread crumbs.
steps.spoken: Dip each piece of veal first in the flour, then in the eggs, and last in the bread crumbs.

steps.instruction: Melt 7 tablespoons of butter in a deep pan, not too hot.
steps.spoken: Melt 7 tablespoons of butter in a deep pan. Do not let it get too hot. The butter should not turn brown.

steps.instruction: Lay the veal in the pan and fry until golden brown.
steps.spoken: Lay the veal in the pan and fry until golden brown, about 3 minutes.

steps.instruction: Flip the veal and fry the other side until golden brown.
steps.spoken: Flip the veal and fry the other side until golden brown, about 3 minutes.

steps.instruction: Serve with a piece of lemon.

ingredients.name: parsley, fresh is best, dried is fine

steps.instruction: Cut 1 tomato, 1 sweet pepper, 1 zucchini and 1 eggplant in half lengthwise.
steps.spoken: Cut the vegetables in half on the long side. You may remove the seeds and some of the pulp from the tomato and the zucchini, but not too much, or you will get just burnt vegetable skin.

steps.instruction: Place the vegetables on baking paper in a baking tray.
Sprinkle parsley over the vegetables.
Sprinkle on a little salt, if you want.
Cover the vegetables with 1 to 1 1/2 cups of grated bread.
Sprinkle 1/2 cup of Parmigiano cheese all over the bread.
Drizzle olive oil over the bread until it is all wet.
steps.spoken: Add enough olive oil to wet all the bread. If you don't use enough oil, the grated bread won't stick together and may burn.

steps.instruction: Bake for 45 minutes in the oven preheated to 340 °F.
steps.spoken: Bake for about 45 minutes in an oven that has been preheated to 340 °F.

ingredients.name: peanut oil, or other suitable frying oil

steps.instruction: Soak 10 ounces of precooked noodles in hot water for 2 minutes.
steps.spoken: Loosen 10 ounces of precooked thick wheat noodles in a bowl of hot water for 2 to three minutes.

steps.instruction: Drain the noodles and set them aside.
Mix 3 tablespoons of soy sauce and 2 tablespoons of oyster sauce in a bowl.
Mix in 2 teaspoons of sesame oil and 2 tablespoons of water.
Heat 2 tablespoons of peanut oil in a wok or large pan over high heat.
Add 1 carrot, cut into thin sticks, and 2 cups of broccoli florets.
steps.spoken: Add the carrot and the broccoli florets. Stir-fry for 2 minutes.

steps.instruction: Add 6 ounces of firm tofu, cut into cubes.
steps.spoken: Add the tofu cubes. Stir-fry for 4 minutes.

steps.instruction: Add 2 cloves of minced garlic and 2 teaspoons of grated ginger.
steps.spoken: Add the garlic and the ginger. Stir-fry for 1 minute.

steps.instruction: Stir in the noodles, the sauce and 1/2 cup of roasted cashews.
steps.spoken: Stir in the noodles, then the sauce and 1/2 cup of roasted cashews. Mix until everything is thoroughly combined and heated through.

source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: Created by the California Walnut Commission, a member of the MyPlate National Strategic Partnership Program

ingredients.name: red or yellow bell pepper, minced
red kidney beans, 16 ounces each, rinsed and drained
tomatoes, 14.5 ounces each, chopped or crushed

steps.instruction: Heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil in a large, deep pan.
Add 1 chopped onion and cook over medium heat until it turns clear.
Add 1 sliced carrot and 1/4 teaspoon of salt.
Add 2 teaspoons of cumin and 2 tablespoons of chili powder.
Cook, stirring, until the spices are toasted.
Crumble 1 pound of ground turkey breast into the pan.
Sprinkle in 1 minced bell pepper.
Cook until the turkey is white and opaque all the way through.
Add 2 cans of kidney beans and 2 cans of tomatoes, stirring gently.
steps.spoken: Add 2 cans of kidney beans and 2 cans of tomatoes. Stir gently so you do not break the beans.

steps.instruction: Bring to a boil, then lower the heat to medium-low.
Cook partly covered for 20 minutes.
Top the chili with 1 1/2 cups of walnuts and parsley.
